    Homogeneous components of maps #

    An internal Hom grading gives finite homogeneous decompositions of every map. Taking degree zero of a composite pairs opposite degrees. This is the identity decomposition used to classify graded indecomposables as shifts.

        With the first factor homogeneous of degree d, only degree -d of the second factor contributes to degree zero of their composite.
